boundary: Automated browser, service-worker and assistive-technology regressions do not substitute for testing on physical iOS/iPadOS and Android devices. Fresh physical validation is required for the current release and must bind to the retained exact-head candidate artifact recorded here, never to the mutable preview branch. Screen-reader conformance remains governed separately by data/accessibility-real-at-validation-v1.json.
privacyBoundary: Public contract metadata must not include learner names, customer/site identifiers, email addresses, private screenshots, raw process data, backup content, filesystem/user paths or other personal/proprietary evidence. Keep detailed device evidence outside the public repository and reference it only with a non-sensitive review identifier.
